gloss: to press against; to force upon

forms.negative: {押|お}し{付|つ}けませんでした

definitions.gloss: to press against; to push onto
definitions.explanation: To physically press something firmly against a surface.

definitions.gloss: to force upon; to push off onto
definitions.explanation: To impose unwanted tasks, responsibilities, or opinions on someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I pressed the stamp onto the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was standing with my back pressed against the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|さ}ました→冷ます：02113_samasu⟧。
examples.english: I pressed ice against my forehead to cool the fever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't force your ideas on other people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面倒|めんどう}な→面倒：03809_mendou⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}けないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't push the troublesome work onto the newcomers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A boss who pushes the blame for failures onto subordinates won't be trusted.

notes:
{押|お}し{付|つ}ける is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) + ⟦{付|つ}ける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to attach). The figurative meaning of forcing things on people is very common.

ASPECT (ている):
{押|お}し⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing pressure or that something has been pressed/forced.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[surface]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける — to press [thing] against [surface]
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける — to force [thing] on [person]
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (push responsibility onto)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (push work onto)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (force one's opinion on)
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (impose one's values)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to force, compel (more formal)
- {押|お}しつけがましい: pushy, overbearing (adjective form)
